sources.title: Original GLM-5.3 release announcement
sources.evidence: The indexed original page is dated August 14, 2026 and explicitly announces release through GLM Coding Plan and ZCode. It states that GLM-5.3 uses the GLM-5.2 base and improves it through post-training, with IndexShare in the inherited training stack. Its local-serving section says weights would follow later. Direct page opening returned an empty shell; the search reader exposed the complete relevant original text.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 pinned model card
sources.evidence: Exact model card identifies the GLM family, public local deployment, text-generation pipeline, same base as GLM-5.2 and post-training changes. It specifies three reasoning-effort levels and links original vLLM/SGLang implementations. License metadata says other, license_name glm-5.3; the cited technical report concerns GLM-5 and does not establish a GLM-5.3 parameter-count convention.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 pinned checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM with 78 main layers (3 dense, 75 sparse), 256 routed experts/top 8 plus 1 shared expert, MLA latent ranks and sparse indexer configuration, one next-token prediction module, untied embeddings and maximum positions 1048576. Indexer types alternate full/shared with index_topk_freq 4; sharing also applies to MTP iterations. Default checkpoint quantization is block FP8.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 License
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint license is named GLM-5.3 License, copyright 2026 Z.AI. It permits weight use, modification and redistribution under stated conditions, including a security-review condition for qualifying large Model-as-a-Service businesses. This is a custom license, not the MIT license of earlier GLM releases.

sources.title: Original developer model download table
sources.evidence: The exact GLM-5.3 FP8 and GLM-5.3-BF16 rows both directly report nominal 744B-A40B. GLM-5.3-Flash has its own separate row. The table does not define whether embeddings, output heads or MTP are included; no predecessor convention is imported.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 native API guide
sources.evidence: Full Markdown page accessed at the .md URL. It specifies text-only inputs, 1M context, 128K maximum output, always-enabled reasoning with low/high/max effort, and function calling. Text responses are shown in exact-model examples. It describes current hosted access separately from open deployment.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 pinned chat template
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint template opens a think block, sets reasoning effort to low/high/max, serializes tool schemas and native function calls, and handles tool responses. The text model has no image/audio generation decoder; generic tokenizer special tokens do not establish extra modalities.

sources.title: Original vLLM GLM-5.3 serving recipe
sources.evidence: The serving recipe linked by the original model card reports approximately 743B total and 39B active, conflicting with the developer download table 744B-A40B. It agrees on text MoE, 1048576 context and native FP8 packaging. The developer-specific nominal table is retained; neither figure is presented as a reconciled exact learned-tensor count.

sources.title: Native model release notes
sources.evidence: The native API release log places GLM-5.3 under August 18, 2026, later than the August 14 original Coding Plan/ZCode release. This later service-entry date does not replace earliest public access.

sources.title: Pinned GLM-5.3 public repository metadata
sources.evidence: The accessed repository is public and ungated, with 141 safetensors shards and local deployment files. No full weight files were downloaded and storage-element metadata was not treated as learned parameter counts.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 pinned tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: model_max_length is 1048576, agreeing with the checkpoint position capacity. Image/video/audio special tokens are tokenizer vocabulary entries, not evidence that this text-only model accepts those modalities.

sources.title: GLM-5 technical report referenced by the current card
sources.evidence: The report was checked for GLM-5.3-specific counting and architecture statements. It does not mention GLM-5.3; its earlier-model table cannot establish the later release's embedding/output/MTP count boundary.

name.note: Exact full-size model, distinct from GLM-5.3-Flash and precision packaging suffixes.

developer.note: Original release and checkpoint are published by Z.ai.

release_date.note: Earliest verified public Coding Plan/ZCode release. The August 18 native API-log entry and later weight publication are distinct distribution milestones.

open_weights.note: Currently public downloadable official weights. They were promised for later at the initial hosted release; true does not imply weights were downloadable on August 14.

license.note: Exact named custom license. Do not inherit MIT from GLM-5.2 or the separately licensed Flash variant.

parameters_b.note: Original developer nominal 744B from the exact GLM-5.3 row. vLLM reports approximately 743B; this conflict is retained. Neither is an exact complete checkpoint count. No exact-model embedding/output/MTP boundary is disclosed.

active_parameters_b.note: Original developer nominal A40B from the exact model row. The vLLM recipe reports 39B. No precise active-count convention or phase-specific accounting is inferred.

architecture.note: Causal text MoE Transformer with latent attention and sparse attention/index sharing. Configuration has 3 dense and 75 MoE main layers, 8 of 256 routed experts plus a shared expert, and one MTP module. Flash's hybrid linear-attention/mHC architecture is not transferred.

context_window.note: Exact open-checkpoint and tokenizer capacity. Native API advertises 1M and may apply its own service limit; the baseline 1000000 is replaced by the configured capacity. 128K maximum output is separate.

modalities.note: Native guide explicitly states text-only input and shows text responses. No vision/audio modules occur in the config; tokenizer special tokens do not establish multimodality.

reasoning.note: Always enabled in the documented interface, with low/high/max effort. Disabling reasoning is explicitly unsupported.

tool_call.note: Exact-model native function calling and checkpoint tool-schema/call/response serialization.

description.value: Text MoE model with sparse attention, adjustable reasoning effort and function calling.
description.note: Neutral description limited to verified architecture and interfaces.

patch.description: Text MoE model with sparse attention, adjustable reasoning effort and function calling.
patch.notes: Released through GLM Coding Plan and ZCode on August 14, 2026; native API release notes are dated August 18 and public weights followed later. The developer lists nominal 744B total and 40B active; the linked vLLM recipe instead gives approximately 743B/39B. The developer figures are retained without claiming exact learned-tensor totals or importing an earlier model's embedding/MTP accounting. The checkpoint uses MoE with latent/sparse attention and shared sparse indexers. Context capacity is 1048576 in the checkpoint and tokenizer, while the hosted guide advertises 1M. Reasoning is always enabled with low/high/max effort. Weights use the custom GLM-5.3 License, not MIT.

summary: Verified all 14 fields. Added the exact custom license, author-nominal 744B/40B counts and independently configured MoE topology; corrected context to 1048576. Preserved the vLLM 743B/39B disagreement without inventing an exact counting boundary. Confirmed August 14 hosted release, later API/weight availability, text-only modalities, always-enabled reasoning and tools.
